facts.fact: The land minister said LEEGOU services will be extended by progressive installation of its branches in all 54 moughataas by 2027.

The land directorate said it is working with the digital ministry to launch AQAAR, a unified national land database giving each parcel a unique identifier, and EL MOUHAFID, a modern property publicity system.
The land directorate said citizens can now access their secured land documents, starting in Nouakchott and then regional capitals.
